name: Combine classified white matter tracts
summary: Merges selected tracts of a white matter classification into new combined tracts with MRtrix3 and outputs the updated tractogram and classification.
description: Extracts each classified tract from the tractogram with connectome2tck, concatenates the tracts listed on each line of combineIndices with tckedit, and builds a new classification (named by mergeNames) and merged tractogram. Use it to combine, for example, left and right or sub-segments of a tract into one bundle.

inputs.description: White matter classification (classification.mat) of the tractogram.

outputs.description: New classification with one tract per line of combineIndices.
Per-tract intermediate .tck files and assignment lists.

parameters.description:
These are the index numbers found within the classification.mat file for the tracts you want to combine. 

For example, if you want to combine the first two tracts from a classification structure, this field would be set as '1 2'.

You can also have multiple sets of tracts combined into individual tracts by separating values by a new line
Names of the newly merged tracts you would like to set. Need to have the same number of names as the number of sets of tracts in combineIndices.

failure_modes.message: combination failed. see logs and derivatives
failure_modes.cause: The new classification was not produced.
failure_modes.fix: Check that combineIndices refer to tract indices present in the classification.
